summary: One collapsible section of a violet-accordion, with a heading slot and a body.

usage.text: Use it inside violet-accordion: its header button only fires a toggle-request event, and the accordion sets the expanded attribute. Alone, a click changes nothing unless the page handles that event.

Header text goes in the heading slot, which renders inside a button, so put no interactive or heading elements there. The body is the default slot. The expanded attribute in markup opens it initially.

a11y.text: The heading-level attribute (1 to 6, default 3) sets the header's aria-level. Match it to the page's heading outline.
